types.name: ToolResultProps
types.doc: The record of one tool call in an agent transcript. Folded, it is a single line: status, tool name, a short summary and how long the call took (counting live while it runs). Open, it shows the input and the output formatted as code, each with a copy button.

members.name: tool
members.doc: Name of the tool that was called.

members.name: summary
members.doc: Short text after the name, usually the main argument.

members.name: durationMs
members.doc: How long the call took, in milliseconds. While `status` is "running" and this is not set, a live timer counts from mount.

members.name: input
members.doc: What the tool was called with. Objects are printed as highlighted JSON; strings are shown as they are.

members.name: output
members.doc: What the tool returned. Same formatting as `input`.

members.name: error
members.doc: Error message, shown in place of the output when `status` is "error".

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the record starts open when uncontrolled.

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called when the header is pressed.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the root element.
